items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: His name was Ralph Dewey. So he got me to play the bass and another friend of mine to play the drums and a saxophone player named Johnny Burdine.

ctx.x: So, one thing led on to another, and then I--the Brass Rail. I started meeting guys, ....younger musician. And there was another grown man. His name was Ralph Dewey. So he got me to play the bass and another friend of mine to play the drums and a saxophone player named Johnny Burdine. All of us was young. We was, you
know, in the same age. And working at a club downtown Tampa called the Brass Rail.
